title: Hail, All Hail the Joyful Morn
description: Hail, All Hail the Joyful Morn in Tonic Solfa to INNOCENTS, doh is D: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 208 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Same”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens (7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to INNOCENTS; any other Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: Hail, all hail the joy-ful morn: Tell it forth from earth to heaven, That to us a child is born, That to us a Son is given.

lines: Hail, all hail the joyful morn:
Tell it forth from earth to heaven,
That to us a child is born,
That to us a Son is given.
Peace — good-will to man on earth."
Join we then our feeble lays
To the chorus of the sky;
And, in songs of grateful praise,
Glory give to God on high.

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to INNOCENTS by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
